program_plain: World: 400 self-propelled disks (radius 1) in a periodic 2D box (square of side 158.5) at area fraction 0.05, hovering at height 1.1 above a flat wall that chemicals cannot cross. Each disk emits a chemical. Rules each step: (1) each disk moves along its heading at speed 2; (2) it is pulled toward the others along the summed gradient of their screened chemical fields (each decays as exp(-k*r)/r, plus a mirror-image source below the wall), screening k = 0.20; (3) its heading is turned away from that same gradient with turning strength 0.30; (4) the heading gets rotational noise (Peclet number 100); (5) disks repel on contact. A cluster is more than 10 disks linked within 2.1 radii. Run 100 tau (tau = 1/rotational diffusion rate, the heading's persistence time).
